artifact_delivered: PPO implementation fixed and validated — clipped objective policy gradient on CartPole
workstream_summary: C532: Fixed PPO implementation (bin/ppo.py) — trajectory batching bug caused single-sample updates, REINFORCE episode length tracking wrong. PPO (64 hidden, 10 epochs, 16 rollout) learned 21→47 avg reward in 1000 episodes, clearly outperforming REINFORCE (10→7.4). Key insight: PPO needs diverse samples per update (batched trajectories) for stable gradients. Single-trajectory updates gave 11→12 reward — no learning. GAE (lambda=0.95) balances TD bias and MC variance. Clipped objective [1-eps, 1+eps] prevents destructive policy updates without conjugate gradient.
